rules.title: Ragged row
rules.message: {count} rows have more or fewer fields than the header.
rules.explanation: These lines have a different number of fields from the header. Missing fields are empty and extra fields are not imported. Check the source for unquoted delimiters or broken lines.
rules.source: RFC 4180 Common Format and MIME Type for CSV Files (2005).

rules.title: Additional table found
rules.message: The sheet holds more than one table; the first was imported ({detail}).
rules.explanation: Only the first table on the sheet was imported. The others are listed so you can import them separately.

rules.title: Multi-row header flattened
rules.message: A header spanning several rows was joined into single column names.
rules.explanation: The column names come from more than one header row (for example a name row and a units row) and were joined. Check the names and units in the preview.

rules.title: Encoding assumed
rules.explanation: The file does not say which text encoding it uses, so one was assumed. If accented letters or symbols look wrong, choose another encoding.

rules.title: Detections assumed
rules.explanation: Tracewell could not be certain about some settings (such as a unit, a date format or the coordinate system) and applied the most likely value. Each one is listed and marked as assumed. Review them and change any that are wrong.
rules.source: Tracewell principle: never block, never hide (SAD section 2.1).

rules.title: Partial import
rules.message: Only part of the file was imported: it exceeds this edition's memory budget.
rules.explanation: The file is larger than this edition can hold in memory, so only the first part was imported. Results for this dataset cover only those rows. Open the file in the desktop edition to import all of it.

rules.title: Original file checksum mismatch
rules.message: An original file in the project has changed: {detail}.
rules.explanation: An imported file no longer matches the checksum recorded when it was imported, so results may not come from the original data. The project is opened read-only.

rules.title: Audit chain broken
rules.message: The audit log does not verify: {detail}.
rules.explanation: An entry of the audit log was changed, removed or reordered after it was written. The history can no longer be trusted, so the project is opened read-only.

rules.title: Replay digest mismatch
rules.message: Rebuilding the project from its originals and audit log gave different results: {detail}.
rules.explanation: The datasets rebuilt from the originals and the audit log do not match the digests saved with the project. The project is opened read-only.

rules.title: Project entry checksum mismatch or unsupported format
rules.message: The project file is damaged or unsupported: {detail}.
rules.explanation: Part of the project file does not match its recorded checksum, or the file was written in a format version this edition cannot read. The project is opened read-only.

rules.title: Export read-back mismatch
rules.message: The exported file did not read back as written: {detail}.
rules.explanation: After writing the export, Tracewell read it back and found a difference. The export is not reported as successful.

rules.title: Format limit substitution
rules.message: A format limit applied to this export: {detail}.
rules.explanation: The destination format could not hold all of the data (for example Excel's row limit), so the export was adjusted as described. Nothing was dropped silently.

rules.title: GeoJSON requires WGS84
rules.message: GeoJSON export needs WGS84 coordinates; this dataset is in {detail}.
rules.explanation: RFC 7946 GeoJSON must use WGS84 longitude/latitude. Coordinate transformation is not available in this edition, so this dataset cannot be exported as GeoJSON. Export it as CSV or Excel instead.
